title: Each picture in a row of pictures says its own name
goal: Rows that offer a choice as small pictures, like the arrow endings and the text alignment buttons, share one tooltip for the whole row, so resting on a picture never tells you what that picture means. Give each picture its own tooltip.
notes: A SwiftUI Picker(.segmented) takes a single .help for the whole control; a per-segment tooltip needs the underlying NSSegmentedControl (setToolTip(_:forSegment:)) reached through an NSViewRepresentable or a view-tree walk. See Sources/Photonz/ArrowheadStylePicker.swift and the alignment rows in LayersPanel.swift. Raised by the 2026-09-06 arrow endings audit.
acceptance: Resting on any one picture in the arrow Ending row shows a tooltip naming that ending
The same is true of the text alignment rows
The row still reads as one control, with no change to its size or spacing
